normalization: original list_v1 C0; same absolute deadline and machines for all plans
input: raw conditions; no queues, selected alternatives or planned timestamps
family_rule: after all plans are frozen, M distinct physical plans across all instances; each rate endpoint alpha=.05/(4M), both laws; each gain/loss endpoint for each registered selected-versus-prefix comparison alpha=.05/(8K). Rate and comparison families are separate simultaneous 95% statements
pareto_rule: all returned representatives frozen on calibration; holdout never selects report members; no global front claim
success_rule: external improvement over actual CP-prefix required for added search benefit; technical completion and feasibility are separate; full CP is historical quality reference, not paired cost comparator
